body:
## Observed behavior
- #12418 (#12271 SessionEnd slice) was verified PASS by qa → transitioned to `status:pending-ship` at 03:44 local (07:44 UTC, 2026-06-15).
- dm (alias `dm`, ../SquidSquad-3) was alive + event-mode the entire time (claude.exe PID 12292, ~28h session).
- ~48 min later (04:32 local) #12418 was STILL `pending-ship`, PR #12441 unmerged, dm had made NO transition/comment — it never picked the item up.
- A manual PM-injected `assigned-to(target_alias=dm)` event via `POST /events` woke dm to ship it.

## Impact
- **DM starves on `pending-ship` work in event mode** — deliveries stall indefinitely without PM manually injecting a wake event. #12342 ("EAD auto-routes pending-test→verifier / pending-ship→dm") was meant to close this and was activated via harness restart, but `pending-ship→dm` did not reach dm in practice.
- Asymmetry worth noting: qa (verifier) picked up its `pending-test` work fine — but qa is **LOOP** mode (it polls), so its success does NOT prove EAD routing works. dm is **EVENT** mode and depends on the EAD `assigned-to` nudge, which didn't fire/reach it. So the EAD auto-route is unproven on the verifier side too and broken on the dm side.

## Leads (for RCA — not prescribing a fix)
- #12418 carried `role:skill` (never re-labeled to `dm`) through `pending-ship` — check whether EAD routes `pending-ship` by STATUS (→ dm) regardless of the `role:*` label, or whether it keys off `role:*` (which would explain the miss).
- Possible alias-target mismatch (the verifier/dm alias-resolution class, cf. #11600).
- Related: #11586 (event delivery gap), #12342 (the fix meant to handle this).

## Workaround in place
PM manually injects `assigned-to(target=dm)` on pending-ship transitions (the documented interim router). Autonomous event-mode delivery is blocked until this is fixed.
title: ISSUE: pending-ship work does not auto-route to dm in event mode (#12342 gap)
